note: Golden embeddings produced by Python sentence-transformers as ground truth for the Rust ONNX pipeline. Each entry is encoded individually with the prefix prepended; output is L2-normalized. `pooling` records the model's pooling mode (mean / cls) so the Rust side can verify it uses the matching pool. Rust ONNX inference (fp32) must match with cosine >= 0.9999; quantized ONNX uses a >= 0.99 acceptance gate.
